preFreshmanVerified.note: Nathan Preece, Rosepine, class of 2030. Before his freshman year he placed 4 in 2026. The LHSAA brackets admitted them: the championship's own participant grades carry fifteen eighth-grade and two seventh-grade entries, which is exactly this set, and the class year on each profile is derived from that published grade - the same field that flags the result as pre-freshman here. The package does not cite an LHSAA by-law, so what is verified is the event's own record of who wrestled, not the rule behind it. Different from Maryland (COMAR 13A.06.03.02, grades 9-12 only) and Virginia (VHSL 28-2-1, eighth graders on junior varsity only), where the same shape proved a class year wrong (28 Oct 2026).
